about: A tool that runs a project's GitLab CI pipeline on your own computer, without pushing.

prs.title: Pipelines with change rules run on projects that use master
prs.broken: If the remote's default branch was not recorded, the tool assumed it was called main. On projects using master, any pipeline with change rules crashed.
prs.changed: I made it check whether main or master exists on the remote and use that one, and name it in the warning.
prs.matters: Older projects, and ones first pushed from a fresh local repo, can test their pipelines locally.
